mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before my initial custom kitchen design consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your initial custom kitchen design consultation, it's beneficial to gather some information and ideas. Consider your functional needs, such as preferred cooking style and storage requirements, and collect inspiration images or a list of desired features. Thinking about your budget range and any existing architectural plans or measurements of your current kitchen can also be very helpful. This preparation allows our designers to better understand your vision and provide relevant solutions during our meeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your design consultation, prepare by considering your functional needs, gathering inspiration images, and defining your budget. Any existing kitchen plans or measurements are also helpful.
